unresolved_choices: The admitted brochure does not publish a configuration-specific carrier overall length or overall height; public-envelope X and Y remain unresolved.
The 15.2 m public lateral constraint is the selected 50-ft header working-span class, not a carrier transport-width claim.
The brochure lists compatible tyre families but does not prove the selected front/rear pair, wheel offsets, final carrier width or ballast as one ordered machine.
Feederhouse lift/tilt pivots, cylinders, header attachment geometry, reel drive, auger hinge, fold law and support hardware are not published.
Internal rotor, conveyor, grain, cleaning and crop-flow geometry is not scale-authoritative in public literature.
Exact panels, cab/glazing, access systems, residue system, lighting, hoses, wiring and service hardware remain unresolved.
Manufacturer colors, graphics, badges and decals are outside the public structural study.
boundary: MY2024 North American X9 1100 wheeled combine candidate with HD50R 50-ft-class draper and 31-ft auger selected. Neutral unbranded visualization only; not manufacturer CAD, an agronomic model, engineering authority, safety guidance or proof of one delivered machine.
